prompt:
Make this exact BLUE MALE GUARD STRONGER and MUCH MORE GRAPHIC in silhouette/design, as requested. Preserve identity, black swept-back hair/ivory temple streak/short beard, compact project head/body proportions, blue/navy/steel/ivory palette, standing three-quarter LEFT facing, halberd and NON-ROUND BILATERALLY SYMMETRIC SHIELD. Do not return to circular shield or add an animal emblem.

PHYSIQUE:
Visibly widen shoulder span and upper back about 20–25 percent, thicken chest/ribcage and upper arms, shorten/thicken the neck slightly. Arms and gripping hand have substantial strength; thighs/calves and boots become sturdier while retaining clear joint structure. Keep a powerful athletic trapezoid torso, slightly narrower functional waist and solid hips, not obese, not elongated bodybuilder anatomy and not exaggerated superhero tiny waist. Actual head size remains compatible with the compact game cast, no shrinking the head.
More planted upright guard stance with one knee softly flexed, comfortable slightly wider foot support than input, both boots on ground; no deep squat. Shield weight believable on the carrying arm, no floating equipment.

GRAPHIC DESIGN — FEWER BIGGER SHAPES:
- Upper-body silhouette becomes a broad INVERTED TRAPEZOID. Exposed shoulder on screen-left wears ONE large blocky cobalt/steel shoulder cap with one lower step, replacing the stacked curled/spiky ornament. Remove the circular spiral shoulder disc. The other shoulder ties into the shield with coherent armor/cloth, not hidden disconnected arm.
- Chest is ONE bold broad navy/cobalt TRAPEZOID breastplate with a strong ivory diagonal crossover collar above it. Remove twin tiny decorative chevrons/fasteners. One broad steel top edge only.
- Waist is a WIDE DARK HORIZONTAL BAND with a single plain rectangular steel buckle, creating decisive upper-body/waist contrast.
- Skirt/tabard has just TWO or THREE LARGE broad unequal panels with clipped corners and one simple ivory edge, no numerous small cloth triangles or layered tiny points. Strong vertical/diagonal rhythm.
- Bracers and boots have wide clean cuffs and big simple steel shin shapes, eliminate fussy ankle straps and little metallic knots. Material plane boundaries are big and deliberate.

SHIELD:
Keep the same large left-right symmetric broad-shouldered tapering shield, blunt bottom point, top center peak, mirrored shoulders and simple plain steel border. Slightly broader/stouter proportions if needed to echo his strength, but don't cover the entire character. One large blue face with a central vertical ridge and exactly two/three principal shaded planes. Remove scratched brush streaks and extra facet fragments. Shield stays clean and free of symbols, jewels, spikes or filigree.
Halberd remains one straight pole with its existing simple spearpoint/side crescent, grip structurally sound. Slightly thicken pole only if needed for stronger hand. No weapon redesign or new props.

PROJECT ICON DRAWING:
Stronger bold dark silhouette, sparse inner contours, broad clean cobalt blue/ink navy/steel value blocks. Main light-shadow pattern organized into FEW large masses; matte 2–3 tones per material. Skin warm and organic with one broad shadow, no tiny face facets or realistic muscles. No grain, clutter, fine engravings, glossy 3D shine or polygon mosaic.
Full single guard on same square plain warm ivory background, all weapon/shield/boots inside safe margins. The result must be visibly broader and sturdier, with a more intentional graphic shape hierarchy; not merely a saturated recolor.
purpose: Broaden male guard physique and strengthen graphic hierarchy with fewer larger armor shapes, preserving blue palette and symmetric non-round shield.
visual_review: Broader shoulder/chest and sturdier arms/legs; major trapezoid breastplate, block shoulder, horizontal belt and fewer skirt panels. Blue symmetric shield retained with cleaner planes.
